name: antislop
turns: The rain has stopped. Ada is still standing in the doorway, coat dripping on the flagstones.

name: interiority

name: bonds-threads
turns: Ada and I are alone in the scriptorium. I ask her why she came back.

I take her hand. She does not pull away, but she does not hold on either.
There is a knock at the door. Neither of us moves to answer it.
